note: The calibration the MODEL ships with (dossier Sec. 24: physical volts inside, conversions at explicit boundaries). These are plugin controls and fixed conventions, NOT Fender numbers and NOT measurements of an interface.

volts_per_full_scale_input_sample.control: Input Cal (V pk @ FS); with Input Trim +-12 dB the jack never exceeds 20 V; the solver is validated to a 30 V peak at the jack

output_reference_volts.unit: V peak at the speaker terminals for 0 dBFS
output_reference_volts.note: rated 12.5 W sine into 8 ohm = 14.14 V peak = -6 dBFS (dossier Sec. 02 derived reference)

source_impedance_ohm.note: line/DI mode; a passive pickup + cable model (6 kohm, 2.5 H, 500 pF) is selectable

fixed_delay_samples.note: the oversampler's whole-sample latency, reported to the host and removed by the offline tools: 2x = 79 / 45 / 13 samples at 44.1 / 48 / 96 kHz; 4x = 87 / 52 / 19; 8x = 90 / 55 / 21; 1x = 0

worked_example_sec24.statement: a sine whose digital peak is -18 dBFS produces 0.100 V RMS at the amp jack
worked_example_sec24.reproduced_by: cd57_validate section 10 (checks K_in = 1.12335 and the engine's digital-to-jack conversion to 0.100 V RMS)

peak_rms_conventions: digital peak A -> jack RMS = K_in A / sqrt(2); peak, RMS and peak-to-peak are never mixed (dossier Sec. 24)
